content.short: Kinza Finance is a DeFi lending hub on Mantle specializing in LST, LRT, BTCFi, and RWA token collateral for borrowing and yield.
content.description: Kinza Finance is a lending protocol on Mantle specializing in supporting emerging asset categories including liquid staking tokens (LSTs), liquid restaking tokens (LRTs), Bitcoin DeFi assets, and real-world assets (RWAs) as collateral for borrowing. The protocol enables users to unlock liquidity from otherwise illiquid staking positions without selling, while lenders earn yield from borrower demand. Kinza serves as a key lending infrastructure provider within the Mantle ecosystem.
